name: Back Office Sign In
description: Sign-in screen for the owner and staff, with password and email-link options and clear error messages.
usage: Give it the /admin/sign-in route and wire onSignIn and onMagicLink to your auth provider; send people back here whenever they aren't signed in. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
